scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia! Do you know Moscovia?
the paradise spreading on the endless seas...
Welcome to Moscovia
It's adventurous and mystic.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚！你知道莫斯科比亚吗？
那是蔓延在无尽海洋上的天堂...
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚
这里充满了冒险与神秘。

scripts.text: About Moscovia...
scripts.translation: 关于莫斯科比亚...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 前往莫斯科比亚

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia is a beautiful kingdom
on an island located north of Rune-
Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚是一个美丽的王国
坐落于卢恩·米德加兹北方的岛屿上。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sure that you will be
absolutely fascinated
by Moscovia's beautiful scenery
and gorgeous palace.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我相信你一定会为莫斯科比亚
美丽的风景和华丽的宫殿
而深深着迷。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Now that our long winter has
passed,
I'm happy that I can now show you
our gorgeous hometown.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
既然漫长的冬季已经过去，
我很开心现在能向你展示
我们华丽的故乡。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you feel like visiting Moscovia
take the chance now!
I'll help you to have a nice trip
to Moscovia!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你想去游览莫斯科比亚，
请抓住现在的机会！
我会协助你开启一段愉快的
莫斯科比亚之旅！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, let us start now.
You should pay me 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia.
But when you come back,
you don't have to pay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
那么，我们现在就开始吧。
前往莫斯科比亚需要支付我10,000 泽尼。
但当你回来时，则无需再次支付。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Can we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我们现在可以出发了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你现在太忙，
请随时再来找我。
我随时准备好引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sorry but you don't have
enough zeny now
You need 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
很抱歉，你现在的
泽尼不足
前往莫斯科比亚需要10,000 泽尼
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, we're leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，我们现在出发。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你现在太忙，
请随时再来找我。
我随时准备好引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
How was your trip?
Do you have good memories from Moscovia?
A ship is now leaving
for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
你的旅程如何？
在莫斯科比亚留下了美好的回忆吗？
现在有一艘船正要
前往卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text: Return to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you want to see more
please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果你还想多看一些，
请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Please come and visit soon.
Ok then, Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
请尽快回来游玩。
那么，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Our dear Csar Alexsay III is in the palace.
He rules over Moscovia.
Please be careful not to cause him any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们亲爱的沙皇 亚历克赛三世就在宫殿里。
他统治着莫斯科比亚。
请务必小心，不要给他添麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please be silent or the Csar will be angry.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
请保持安静，否则沙皇会生气的。
